_definitions.signature:
SL5h-G G2 — SL5h signatures per pb5 x conversion A / B / C (CPU, .venv-ag3s).

Inputs: outputs/verify/SL5h-G/analysis_<set>.json (SL5h analyze.py unchanged, SL5h-G registry),
        outputs/verify/SL5h-G/calls/*.json, probe/*.json; SL5h summary.py ep_extra (z attribution, policy z sign) imported unchanged.
Signature fields (SL5h definitions, AG3S/ag3s/docs/handoff/SL5h.verify.json numbers._definitions):
  overlift            = episodes with max target rise > 250 mm
  lifted_exec_sat     = lifted env steps with any executed arm component |a| >= 0.999 / lifted env steps (also z >= 0.999)
  Dstar_z_median      = median of Dstar_z = FK_z(refined[k,4]) - FK_z(reference[k,4]) (mm) over lifted calls with conversion clipping
  realised_median     = median realised_frac_obs over the same calls (projection of eef_obs(o+5)-FK(ref[k,4]) on Dstar / |Dstar|^2)
  realised_model      = median conversion.realisation.realised_fraction_median over lifted calls
  closing_rows_up_down= TO-changed rows of closing+lifted optimized calls with FK z change > +0.5 mm / < -0.5 mm
  closing_reach_false = closing+lifted calls with grasp.evidence.checks.reach False / closing+lifted calls
  (same pair for held+lifted rows; all lifted calls with reach False)
Reference rows from SL5h (SL5c A, SL5c B, pb1-B, which lack MI gate / arms / pb4-pb5 rules) are copied from SL5h numbers.json.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5h-G/g2_signature.json
_definitions.classes:
SL5h-G G3 — SL5g #3 failure-cause classes for VLA-only success -> pb5-x failure episodes (CPU, read-only).

Classes (SL5g classify_failures.py, first match wins; obs incl. wait; MuJoCo track from SL5h mj_probe_h.py):
  A_no_lift_hold    : never lifted, longest HOLD run >= 5 calls
  A_no_lift_other   : never lifted, longest HOLD run < 5
  B_lifted_lost     : lifted, then >= 10 consecutive obs with no both-finger grasp and rise < 30 mm
  C_lifted_overlift : lifted, not lost, max target rise > 250 mm
  D_lifted_other    : lifted, not lost, max rise <= 250 mm
lifted = both finger sides touch the target body (dist <= 0) and target rise >= 30 mm, obs >= wait.
HOLD run = maximal run of consecutive calls with hold True (SL5g failure_logs.hold_runs, imported unchanged).
Applied to B (task), C (side by side) and A (same rule). C is cross-checked against SL5g failure_classes.json pb5.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5h-G/g3_classes.json
_definitions.aggregate:
SL5h-G G1 — aggregate + transitions + candidate rules (same definitions as SL5g agg_pairing_rules.py). CPU, read-only.

Per set and version: official / collided / safe_success (SafeLIBERO only) / HOLD (safe_client.hold_calls; episodes with >= 1).
Transitions on the same (task, init, policy seed, obstacle) pair: counts of T->T, T->F, F->T, F->F per metric.
Candidate rules (counted separately, SL5g #1/#2):
  (a) official F->S : VLA-only official False -> version official True
  (b) safe F->T     : VLA-only safe_success False -> version safe_success True (of which VLA-only collided)
  plus regression official T->F, collided -> free, free -> collided.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5h-G/g1_aggregate.json
_definitions.g0:
SL5h-G G0 — parallel bit reproduction: repro (SL5h-G, parallel batch) vs SL5g pb5-C LIBERO 10 (CPU, read-only).

Compared, per episode (10 episodes, LIBERO 10 init 0):
  (1) every array of <stem>.npz, <stem>_calls.npz, <stem>_geom.npz: same key set, dtype, shape, and bytes
      (np.array_equal with equal_nan, plus tobytes() sha1). Arrays are loaded one key at a time.
  (2) episodes.jsonl: every field; result fields listed separately.
  (3) <stem>_calls.jsonl: every leaf (recursive), counted by leaf path; first differing call per path.
First difference (if any) = lowest (episode, file, array) in sorted order and, for calls arrays, the first call index.
Output: outputs/verify/SL5h-G/g0_bitrepro.json
